entries.averment: The complainant is the payee or the holder in due course of the cheque(s).
A company complainant pleads the authorisation of the person representing it (authorised representative / board resolution).

source.ref: A.C. Narayanan v. State of Maharashtra

entries.averment: Where the accused is a company, the persons sought to be made vicariously liable were in charge of and responsible for the conduct of the business at the relevant time.

source.ref: s.141 NI Act; S.M.S. Pharmaceuticals v. Neeta Bhalla

entries.averment: The payee's bank branch falls within this court's territorial jurisdiction.
Where the notice was returned refused/unclaimed, deemed service is expressly averred and the cause of action is computed from the deemed delivery date.

source.ref: C.C. Alavi Haji v. Palapetty Muhammed

entries.averment: Where the complaint is filed beyond one month of the cause of action, a condonation application under the proviso to s.142(b) is attached.
